Package hkust.marketplace.ui

package hkust.marketplace.ui
JavaFX screens of the Buyer Portal (Task 1.1 to 1.10) and the shared look used by the other portals.
  • Class
    Description
    AdminPortal
    Task 3 dashboard.
    AppContext
    Shared state of the running app: the services, the main window and the logged-in user.
    BrowseView
    Browse Marketplace (Task 1.3): approved listings with search, filters and sorting.
    BuyerLoginView
    Buyer login (Task 1.2).
    BuyerPortal
    The buyer portal shell: a menu on the left and the selected page on the right.
    BuyerRegisterView
    Buyer registration form (Task 1.1).
    ChatWindow
    Private chat about one listing (Task 1.5): free text, formal offers shown as cards, permanent and searchable history.
    DealDialogs
    Dialogs for making an offer, a borrow request, a claim and a report (Tasks 1.4 and 1.5).
    HistoryView
    Deal History (Task 1.9): every finished purchase, borrow and giveaway, searchable and filterable.
    ListingDetailDialog
    Listing Detail (Task 1.4), opened from Browse Marketplace or My Deals.
    MyDealsView
    My Deals (Task 1.6): every offer, borrow request and claim, with actions to reopen the listing or chat, answer a counter-offer, withdraw, return a borrowed item early or mark a deal complete.
    MyReviewsView
    The reviews this buyer has written, with any seller replies (Task 1.10).
    NotificationsView
    Notifications (Task 1.8): deal, chat, borrowing and review updates with filters and read state.
    Page
    A screen inside the buyer portal.
    ProfileView
    Manage Profile (Task 1.7): view the username, edit full name and hall, and change the password.
    ReviewDialog
    Rate and review the seller of a finished deal (Task 1.10).
    Ui
    Shared look and helpers so every screen (and the Seller/Admin portals) looks the same.
    WelcomeView
    First screen: pick a portal.
